content.comment_body: Hello, I need to install a [company_name] [product_name] and a [product_name] display in separate rooms. Is there a recommended maximum cable length for this setup? Is the connection a standard RS232 cable pinout? Would a CAT5e cable be suitable? Thanks for any help, [user_name]
Hello, According to the [product_name] manual, the cable length can be up to 10 meters. An RS232 cable should work. However, some users in the forum have managed to connect over longer distances.
Hello, Thanks for your quick response! [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are requesting information on the maximum cable length between a [product_name] device and a corresponding display. Documentation indicates a 10-meter limit, although some community members have used longer cables. There is also interest in cable type compatibility, including RS232 and CAT5e options, as well as pinout specifications. The discussion highlights the need for clearer technical guidance and easy-to-understand cabling instructions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect official recommendations regarding maximum cable length, confirmation of RS232 cable compatibility, and advice about using CAT5e as an alternative. They also want a clear explanation of the required pinout configuration.
